# Airborne 0.3.24
- Flu test positivity now comes directly from CDC FluView, with a freshness-checked Delphi fallback to preserve current reporting coverage. - State wastewater levels and history use CDC's published state values and categories. Local readings use the median measured wastewater value with clearer attribution. - Illness headlines, reporting dates, and history agree on the current observation week. Expired cached observations no longer drive current headlines. - Emergency-visit direction preserves CDC's published labels and unavailable readings.
The proposed briefing and map redesign remain separate from this update.
